description: Expose live IoT data as queryable spatial rows (spatial anchor + timestamp + metric + value) so /api/v1/query and the analytics egress can serve real-time IoT into PowerBI/spreadsheets. Includes capping the node_log cache (IoT-frequency safety), time-series query support, and an external-API ingestion hook.
wave_rationale: Makes 'integrate IoT services for spatial reporting' real. Parallel to / behind analytics_egress (the egress surfaces IoT rows flow through). Shares the node_log cap with p2p_unblock_now FR-2.

alignment.rationale: The IoT half of the primary spatial-reporting goal; fe-terrain has IoT plumbing but no reporting-facing queryable shape.
